messages:
rita: ran a quick usability pass on the routing editor and preview. found a few small things that trip new users:
- reordering rules feels visually unclear: the dragged card floats but the list doesn't make obvious room until you drop. hard to predict final position.
- preview panel shows "Matched: Rule X" but gives no context when a later fallback wins. users ask 'why did my request go to target B?'
lee: agree on the drag. simple improvement is a live placeholder that expands where the item will land, plus a subtle shadow on the drag ghost. keeps motion smooth.
anya: accessibility bits: keyboard move needs clear affordance. suggest a small aria-label on the drag handle: 'Move rule up' / 'Move rule down' and announce via aria-live: 'Moved <rule name> to position <n>'. Also, ensure focus returns to the rule after closing any popover.
morgan: copy notes: the validation snackbar just says "invalid selector" today. that's not actionable. propose: 'Rule "{name}" — match expression invalid: missing wildcard in path. Open rule'. the 'Open rule' part should be a link that jumps to the offending rule.
rita: for the preview trace, UX suggestion: show a compact timeline toggle (Summary / Step-through). Summary = the matched route + key badges; Step-through = collapsed steps listing each rule and why it passed/failed (showing evaluated field and value). keeps the panel uncluttered by default.
lee: css quick mock I tried:
```
.rule-placeholder { height: 56px; border-radius: 6px; border: 2px dashed var(--muted-300); transition: height .12s ease; }
.dragging .card { box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); transform: translateY(-2px); }
```
should be enough to make drop intent clear.
anya: another a11y nit: the overflow menu steals focus; when it closes focus should either go back to the rule title or to the next actionable element. failing to restore focus breaks screen reader flow.
morgan: empty states: the rules list currently reads 'No rules yet'  change to: 'No routing rules yet — click Create rule to add one.' for clearer next step. preview empty state: 'No simulated requests. Paste a request or load sample traffic to test routing.'
rita: tiny layout ask: can badges on rule cards be compressed into a single row with ellipsis for long expressions? when we reorder on narrow screens they wrap and make cards taller than the design intended.
lee: yes collapse to badges with tooltip on hover; ensure badges expose full expression via title and an accessible name for screen readers.
design-bot: reminder: design crit Friday 9:00am. Add items: drag placeholder demo, preview step-through mock, validation copy proposals, a11y focus restore.
rita: action items: @lee to post a short GIF of the placeholder + shadow approach, @anya to draft aria-live messages and focus restore steps, @morgan to write revised toast and empty-state copy. Aim to iterate next sprint and test with keyboard-only flow. Thanks! :raised_hands:
